titulo: CROSSING BORDERS, RC PORTO UNIÃO - UNIÃO DA VITÓRIA PAYS A VISIT TO THE ROTARY CLUB MILANO FIERA PORTA NUOVA IN MILAN-IT
resumo: On the night of 04/29/26 we had the honor of participating in a meeting of the Rotary Club Milano Fiera Porta Nuova, in Milan, Italy, where we were received with great affection and hospitality. The night was marked by an important lecture given by Gianni Guidotti, addressing one of Rotary International's biggest commitments: the eradication of polio in the world. The importance of fellow members' engagement in the PolioPlus Society was also reinforced, further strengthening this global movement. The club visited is made up of committed, active members who are truly committed to serving, reflecting the Rotary spirit in practice. The companions, president of RC Porto União União da Vitória, Thiago Jorge Iwanko, and Daniela Bochnia Iwanko, felt at home and record here a special thanks to president Marco Paini and secretary Alessandro Mantini for their reception and leadership. Moments like this show that, regardless of the language or country, we speak the same language: that of good. We remain united, connected and inspired… because Rotary is, above all, a great network of friendship and purpose. 🤝🌍🇧🇷🇮🇹

titulo: PIZZA SOLIDARITY IN PROVIDING THE VACCINATION CAMPAIGN AGAINST POLIO
resumo:

titulo: ROTARY IN ACTION FOR THE ENVIRONMENT
resumo: During the 40th Feijoada of the Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória, 150 tree seedlings were used as table arrangements and distributed to participants. titulo: 40TH FEIJOADA OF THE ROTARY CLUB OF PORTO UNIÃO - UNIÃO DA VITÓRIA
resumo: The 40th edition of the traditional Rotary Feijoada of União da Vitória, held at Clube 25 de Julho, combined flavor, solidarity and environmental awareness in a single event. This year, in addition to raising funds for social projects, the action highlighted the distribution of 150 tree seedlings, used as table arrangements and given to guests as an invitation to plant a better future. The initiative was made possible through a partnership with the Municipality of União da Vitória, the Municipal Department of the Environment and the Instituto Água e Terra – PR. The proposal reinforces Rotary's commitment to sustainability, by showing that caring for people also means caring for the planet. Another important result of the feijoada was the acquisition of 22 wheelchairs, through the "Mobility for All" project, which benefits people with mobility difficulties. The delivery of the equipment reinforces the social impact of the event, which has transformed lives in the community for four decades. Rotary's Feijoada continues to be a milestone in the region's social and philanthropic agenda, combining tradition, solidarity and innovation in each new edition. Rotary's commitment to inclusion and mobility began to take shape in 2006, with the arrival of the first container of wheelchairs from the Free Wheelchair Mission in Brazil. The initiative originated in 2004, when the then governor of District 4630, Amaury Couto, participated as a team leader in the IGE – Study Group Exchange exchange program in the United States. During the experience, Couto learned about the North American humanitarian mission and was challenged to organize the reception and distribution of a container with 500 wheelchairs on Brazilian soil. Back in the country, he invited Rotarian Renata Mestriner Krambeck, a specialist in foreign trade, to facilitate the import process and logistical coordination of the action. The first shipment arrived in 2006, marking the beginning of a strong partnership between Rotary and Free Wheelchair Mission. Since then, the project has grown significantly and, by July 2025, it has already distributed 12,880 wheelchairs in all regions of Brazil, through 22 partner Rotary Districts. Currently, around 2,000 chairs are received per year, directly benefiting people with disabilities or reduced mobility and promoting dignity, independence and social inclusion. The success of the program is the result of collaborative work between Rotarians, humanitarian organizations and local authorities, and reflects the ideal of service that drives Rotary.

titulo: MANAGEMENT BOARD POSSIBLE 2025-2026
resumo:
Last Monday, July 1st, the Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória held its inauguration ceremony for the new board of directors for the period 2025-2026. The meeting took place at the Suprema Grill restaurant and brought together guests, local authorities, members of civil society and fellow Rotarians.



The club's presidency will now be led by Thiago Jorge Iwanko, who succeeds Marcos Antônio Sauran. With the international motto “United to do good”. During the event, the inaugurated president, Thiago, highlighted the value of unity among Rotarians and the importance of continuing the actions that have benefited the community. “When everyone puts their skills at the service of the common good, Rotary becomes stronger and we are able to achieve results that transform lives”, he highlighted.



Globally, Rotary International is present in more than 200 countries and territories, with around 1.2 million members distributed across more than 35,000 clubs. The organization is known for leading humanitarian initiatives focused on health, education, sanitation, environmental protection and peace promotion. In Brazil, the Rotary network maintains a strong presence in all regions, promoting projects with high social impact.



One of Rotary's main global flagships is the End Polio Now program, responsible for reducing polio cases worldwide by more than 99% since 1985. Currently, the definitive eradication of the disease is closer than ever, representing one of the greatest public health efforts in recent history.



In its local operations, the club has also achieved significant results. Only in recent months, the Rotary of Porto União – União da Vitória made it possible to donate 22 wheelchairs free of charge to residents of the city who needed the equipment, reaffirming its social role and its effective presence in the community.



With a new cycle beginning, the club intends to intensify partnerships, strengthen ties and expand social impact projects in the two cities that make up its base of operations.

titulo: ROTARY PORTO UNIÃO - UNIÃO DA VITÓRIA RECEIVES TRIBUTE ON THE CENTENNIAL OF PORTO UNIÃO
resumo:
At the meeting of the City Council of Porto União (SC) on November 7, 2017, the Rotary Club Porto União – União da Vitória received the Motion of Applause and the Contestado Medal, which is part of the city's centenary celebrations, and which honors people, entities and institutions, in their various segments, who contributed to the city's development.

We are immensely grateful to receive this honor, which came as a recommendation from councilor and fellow Rotarian Christian Martins, and which also paid tribute to doctor Ary Carneiro Júnior, who is a member of our Club and, in addition to his immense dedication in the area of ​​health, has already contributed to the development of our municipality as mayor.


These honors show the value of being a Rotarian! Congratulations to all of us and thank you for the honor!

#sourotary.

titulo: ROTARY PORTO UNIÃO - UNIÃO DA VITÓRIA MAKES A CARREAT TO MOBILIZE THE POPULATION ABOUT POLIO
resumo:
In 2017, as of August 9, only 8 cases of wild polio virus infection had been recorded worldwide: 5 in Afghanistan and 3 in Pakistan.

Here in Brazil, we haven't had the disease for years. But for it to continue like this, all children up to 5 years of age must be vaccinated. Therefore, the Rotary Club Porto União - União da Vitória, the Rotaract Club of Porto União - União da Vitória and the Casa da Amizade de União da Vitória, made a motorcade mobilizing the entire population of the sister cities to vaccinate their children!


That's why we say: VERY LITTLE LEFT to end polio! But we need everyone's support!

titulo: ROTARY PORTO UNIÃO - UNIÃO DA VITÓRIA DELIVERS FOOD TO FOUR ENTITIES
resumo:
This week, we were able to be an instrument of donation and help to others. A few days ago, the Franzoi family gave us the mission to deliver the food collected at a party they organized.

For us, in addition to being happy for the trust, it was further proof that kindness generates kindness, love generates love and that everyone can do a little to help others and make a difference in a world with so much indifference.

In addition to the donation from the Franzoi family, we also delivered basic food baskets from our special partner: Fundação Nova Vida.


The result was four benefiting entities: Instituto Palazollo, Acardi II, Associação Casa de Apoio Santa Clara and Associação Recanto da Sobriedade (Ares).

titulo: RC PORTO UNIÃO - UNIÃO DA VITÓRIA HELP FAMILIES VICTIMS OF THE HURRICANE

titulo: ENVIRONMENT: PLANTING TREES SYMBOLIZES FRIENDSHIP AND GOOD WILL
resumo:
To celebrate Environment Week, on June 4th, Rotarians from the Clube de Porto União - União da Vitória, planted around 50 fruit trees on the banks of Avenida Perimetral, one of the largest avenues in Porto União. They replicated an action that has been carried out by Rotary clubs since its creation, which is to plant trees to symbolize friendship and goodwill.

Afterwards, Rotarians distributed tree seedlings in the city center.

This action had the support of Porto União City Hall, the Municipality's Environment Secretariat, the Timbó River Committee and also the Hobi Group, which donated the seedlings. We had the honor of having representatives of these entities present at the tree planting, especially the mayor of Porto União, Anízio de Souza.

titulo: CLUB OF PORTO UNIÃO - UNIÃO DA VITÓRIA PARTICIPATES IN DISTRICT ASSEMBLY
resumo:
On the 13th, 14th and 15th, we participated in the District Assembly of District 4740, in Joaçaba. The event took place in the Afonso Dresch auditorium, at Unoesc, and was marked by lectures and training for Rotary leaders. Among the guest speakers were Alexander Baer and Edinho Barbosa, who gave an extra dose of motivation to the participants. Furthermore, many new features were presented during the training sessions, where more than 7 parallel rooms discussed specific topics related to Rotary Service Committees.

The idea of the Assembly is to be training for people, leadership training. The host of the event was elected governor Claudia Barbieri, who takes office in the district in July.

We were very happy with the entire event and the knowledge gained. We return with more energy to develop actions in our Club!

titulo: VISIT OF THE GOVERNED COUPLE IN PORTO UNIÃO AND UNIÃO DA VITÓRIA
resumo:
The Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória had the honor of receiving the visit of the governor couple Moacir Schaly and Maria Cristina Thibes Schaly to the cities of Porto União/SC and União da Vitória/PR.
The program began with a meeting with our club members, at which time the governor presented the main guidelines, goals and guidelines for the Rotary year, strengthening everyone's alignment and commitment to Rotary's purposes.
Afterwards, we had the opportunity to present a little about our cities and their main tourist attractions, in addition to visiting the Steinhaeger Double W factory, a traditional company in the region.
We were also in the office of the mayor of União da Vitória, Ary Carneiro Filho, a member of our club and former governor of District 4740, in a moment of integration and appreciation of Rotary's presence in our community.
Closing the program, an Interclub meeting was held, bringing together the Rotary Club of Porto União – União da Vitória, the Rotary Club of União da Vitória – Porto União and the Rotary Club of União da Vitória São Cristóvão. It was a meeting marked by companionship, the exchange of experiences and the strengthening of the ties that unite the clubs in our region.

titulo: NEW BOARD OF DIRECTORS POSSIBLE 2026-227
resumo:
On July 15, 2026, we had the inauguration of the club's new board of directors who will work together with our president Dr. Stefan Grube Kolb, who begins his journey inspired by the motto “Create Lasting Impact”.
More than performing good deeds, creating a lasting impact means leaving positive marks that remain over time, strengthening the club, the community and the lives of the people we serve.
We wish the new board much success, unity and wisdom in this new cycle. May it be a management of great achievements, capable of transforming good ideas into actions and actions into a lasting legacy for our club and the entire community.

titulo: 41ST ROTARY SOLIDARITY FEIJOADA: A TRUE SUCCESS! 💙💛
resumo:
More than serving delicious feijoada, Rotary fulfilled its mission of serving others, transforming each participation into support for projects and actions that benefit our community. This is the true purpose of Rotary: bringing people together to create lasting, positive impact.

We also promote an important environmental action in partnership with the Instituto Água e Terra and the Municipality of União da Vitória/PR. Each table received a tree seedling, which they could take home, encouraging care for the environment and leaving a legacy that will continue to grow for many years. 🌱

To everyone who was with us, our most sincere thank you! Every ticket purchased, every hour of volunteer work and every gesture of support made a difference.

Together, we continue to show that serving means transforming lives. Until the next edition! 💙💛
